new_findings.text: The 'you cannot switch while the visible bar reads empty' equivalence is not an inference — it is one line of web v0.717 code. The HUD bar writer computes its fill as (raw - 48) / (max - 48) and prints the CANNOT-CHANGE-STANCE string precisely when that ratio is 0, which is the same raw < 48 predicate the stance-switch guard uses. Source and frame therefore agree with no arbitration needed.

new_findings.text: The web v0.717 build is not data-free. It embeds 27 XML/binary blobs: nineteen <animdata> tables (100-118), one <survivalmodedata> (119), one room-object definition file (93), five name tables (94-98) and one GIF89a (92). What it does NOT embed is the four gameplay tables — itemdata, skilldata, npcdata, questdata — which it URL-loads. Any restatement of 'the web build ships no data XML at all' must be narrowed to those four or it contradicts the Stage-0 S0-1 inventory.

new_findings.lane_impact: Cross-lane bookkeeping — animation timings, the survival-mode table, room-object definitions and the NPC name generator ARE web-side v0.717 artifacts and do not carry the 0.682 caveat. Only itemdata/skilldata/npcdata/questdata do.

new_findings.text: The web v0.717 PayUI carries the SAME five USD price points as android v0.682 — 4.99 / 9.99 / 14.99 / 19.99 / 24.99 — in its non-Kongregate branch, alongside a 50/100/150/200/250 KREDS ladder for the Kongregate branch. That is what makes the gold change a pure redenomination: identical real money buys 5x more nominal heavenly gold on web, and that gold buys 1/5 the coins. Neither surveyed claim cites this line, though one asserts it.

new_findings.lane_impact: L10/L11 — the USD anchor is build-invariant, so real-money value per tier is the correct cross-build unit and nominal gold is not. It also fixes the top-tier anomaly's meaning: web tier 5 gives 400 gold for the same 24.99 that buys 75 android gold, a 5.33x bonus tier rather than a broken multiplier.

new_findings.text: Which premium tile is item 2125 ('10 Duel Tokens') cannot be settled from the artifacts in this packet, and two surveyed claims give opposite answers. In the 48:04 shop the skull icons split into two families: three GREY skulls at badges 5 / 10 / 15 and two GOLD skulls at badges 1 and 10. The DUEL TOKENS counter in the same frame's top bar uses a WHITE/GREY skull, which points at the grey family (badges 5/10/15 against heavenlyprice 1/2/3, a clean x5) — but the tile order that a PremiumData-derived mapping produces points at the gold family instead. Until a hover tooltip names one of the five skull tiles, this is STILL_UNHELD.

new_findings.lane_impact: L3/L10 — do not bank any per-SKU premium price that depends on the skull-tile mapping. The three badge-1 tiles remain a fact; naming the third one does not. Closing this needs one hover tooltip over a skull tile from any shop session in either longplay.
